items.text: fixed the station ghost of tram stops being drawn wider and thicker than the stop it places
fixed one unreadable saved game hiding all the others; it now shows as damaged and the rest still open
fixed the calculating trips tag going away minutes before the trips after a change were all calculated
after you turn a line's trains on or off, the intercity lines through that city show their new riders within seconds
holding ctrl while snapping to streets pauses the snap
one-way arrows are spaced evenly along the track, and bus one-way arrows show from further out
fixed the real world network snap for tram track missing some real tram corners and links, like on Melbourne's route 82 and at Zurich's main station
one way stations and stations with no passing loop grow with the map like other stations when zoomed in, with a longer bump on the platform side
fixed the snap beside button sitting off the end of the track bar on phones
fixed double track drawing wider than single track in the traffic view, line width now follows riders only
